name: BBsolve
title: Solving Nonlinear System of Equations - A Wrapper for dfsane()

origin.description: Expands method, M, and Nelder-Mead. For two to twenty parameters the default tries Nelder-Mead first.

arguments.name: control
arguments.text: NM defaults to c(TRUE, FALSE) when the length of par is from 2 to 20, and to FALSE otherwise.

origin.details: The default small system starts with Nelder-Mead, using the same simplex as stats::optim.
origin.value: The same list the R function returns for this case.
